parts.name: S1 IC-A2
parts.text: Here I’m going to talk about what you develop in yourself as you reparent your inner child. I’m going to talk about it in terms of three jobs: your loving Nurturer, your safe Adult Protector (hereafter just the Protector) and your wise Guide. That’s one grown-up doing three jobs, not three more people moving in to help with the rent, and each job keeps the others in balance. It’s you that needs to develop these qualities.
parts.why: his inner child guide's whole sentence, his rent joke back, in place of IC-A2's cut one (Low, 16 words, last time); no API check: a Low window isn't reproduced alone (E226)

parts.name: S2 EM-2
parts.text: So, I came up with the idea of constructing a bridge – a temporary fix – a borrowed adulthood, if I can put it that way. It’s made up of a number of familiar practices (such as modeling and supported action), even though I’m not claiming the whole sequence has been proven as one treatment.

parts.name: S3a RR-4.6
parts.text: Put yourself in a place where you can safely do this. Don’t do this if you’re driving, in the water, operating machinery, or otherwise need to be attending to yourself or other people. If you are intoxicated, acutely confused, or not able to keep yourself safe, then get some immediate support instead of doing exploratory hypnosis. If you are already partially or fully opened, you can use the later ‘Already open? Contain before you deepen’ section to help orient yourself, but do not attempt to deepen yourself if you are not stable.

parts.name: S3b RR-4.1
parts.text: Deciding to do it. How will you coax yourself to do this? Make it spacious? Make it warm and held? Something else? Preview what you are going to do: will you close your eyes? Will you come out and go back in again? What will you do at the end? If you are going to use a recording, read the script if you can. Remind yourself that if you say ‘stop’ at any time, the induction will end. If you say ‘less’, you will be asked to do less. If you say ‘quiet’, the talking will stop. You can also just open your eyes and stop, and then come all the way back anyway. You don’t need to ask any parts for permission to stop, even if a part tells you that you do.

Telling them to just access their adult is like telling a baby bird to just fly.

parts.text: Get clear on what it is you want to do during the induction. What do you want not to do today? How long do you want to spend on this? (You don’t have to do this on a problem. You can do it on something you want to experience more of: love, play, confidence, creativity, communion, whatever.) Make sure you’re leaving some time at the end to come back, and reflect on what you experienced.

parts.name: neighbour of S3b RR-4.1: the paragraph after it
parts.text: If you are new to this or haven’t done it for a while, work on the coming in and coming out part first, don’t bring in the hard stuff till later. You don’t have to watch yourself all the time, but for the first time, make sure you can change state. Let yourself make it easier and easier to do this and notice that it takes less and less of you to do it. A no will stay a no. The narrator can’t add stuff just because you don’t say anything.
